230: def count_nodes(answer, budget) -> int:
231:     """Count nodes in an answer, exiting early once the count exceeds budget."""
232:     count = 0
233:     stack = [answer]
234:     while stack:
235:         node = stack.pop()
236:         count += 1
237:         if count > budget:
238:             return count
239:         if isinstance(node, dict):
240:             stack.extend(node.values())
241:         elif isinstance(node, list):
242:             stack.extend(node)
243:     return count
